account.security.title: Account security
account.security.lead: Your password, second factors, recovery codes and the places you are signed in.
account.password.title: Password
account.password.heading: DBLoom password
account.password.lead: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
account.factors.title: Second factors
account.factors.lead: A second factor protects your account if your password is stolen. Changing one asks you to confirm it is you.
account.passkeys.title: Passkeys
account.passkeys.lead: Confirm with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key. Up to 10.
account.passkeys.removeBody: {name} stops working for sign-in and confirmation. Your other sessions end.
account.passkeys.removeLast: {name} is your last second factor. The server may refuse to remove it while two-factor sign-in is required.
account.totp.title: Authenticator app
account.totp.on: An authenticator app is set up.
account.totp.removeBody: Codes from the app stop working. Your other sessions end.
account.totp.removeLast: This is your last second factor. The server may refuse to remove it while two-factor sign-in is required.
account.codes.title: Recovery codes
account.codes.lead: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once, in place of a second factor. They are not shown again.
account.codes.label: Recovery codes
account.recovery.low: Only a few codes are left. Make new ones soon.
account.recovery.none: No codes left. Make new ones so you can get back in if you lose a factor.
account.recovery.regenBody: The old codes stop working at once. The new ones are shown once.
account.disable.title: Turn off two-factor sign-in
account.disable.lead: Removes every passkey, the authenticator app and the recovery codes.
account.disable.body: Your account will be protected by the password alone. Where the site requires a second factor, this is refused.
account.stepup.title: Confirm it is you
account.stepup.lead: This change needs a recent confirmation. Confirm, and the change goes through.
account.stepup.passkeyLead: Your browser asks you to confirm with your device.
account.sessions.title: Where you are signed in
account.sessions.lead: Sign out any session you do not recognise.
account.sessions.revokeAria: Sign out the session of {client} at {address}
account.notices.title: Recent security events
account.notices.lead: Things that happened to your account.
account.notice.recovery_redeemed: A recovery link was used for your account.
account.notice.admin_invite_issued: An invite for an administrator was issued.
account.notice.session_evicted: A session was signed out because you reached the session limit.
account.notice.sessions_revoked: An administrator signed out your sessions.
account.notice.new_location: A sign-in from a new location was seen.
account.notice.failed_burst: A burst of failed sign-in attempts was seen.
account.prefs.title: Preferences
account.prefs.lead: Changes are saved as you make them.
account.prefs.stateless: This server does not keep preferences. Changes last until you sign out.
account.prefs.noTarget: Settings for a server appear here once you are connected to it.
account.prefs.manageLead: Preferences are kept as a file you can move to another account or server. The file holds no passwords.
account.prefs.notSaved: Could not be saved. Your change was not stored.
account.prefs.draft.range: That number is outside the allowed range.
account.reset.title: Reset preferences
account.reset.lead: Puts every preference back to its default.
account.reset.confirmBody: Every preference goes back to its default. Export them first if you may want them again.
account.export.title: Export
account.export.lead: Download your preferences as a JSON file.
account.export.failed: The file could not be made.
account.import.title: Import
account.import.lead: Read preferences from a file made by Export. Every entry is checked first.
account.import.fileHint: A JSON file, up to 256 KiB.
account.import.mode: When a preference is already set
account.import.problemsBlocked: Nothing was saved. {count} entries have problems.
account.import.reason.invalid_file: This is not a DBLoom preferences file.
account.import.reason.file_too_large: The file is larger than 256 KiB.
account.import.reason.wrong_section: In the wrong section of the file.
account.import.reason.too_many_targets: Too many servers in the file.
